about: Per-model OpenRouter provider pins. proxy.py adds `provider` = the pin's `provider` object to a call for that model, unless the client sent its own `provider`. Keys are model ids without a bench variant suffix (`@nojson`). Each pin is the provider that served most of the model's calls in full6 (2026-11-04, scratchpad full6/server/calls.jsonl); `basis` records that share. Change a pin here, not in code.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.basis: full6: Wafer served 378 of 2090 calls (18.1%); about 25 providers served the rest
